purpose: Record source-review aggregates and the actual directly read files without publishing the entire private repository tree.

definitions.full_direct_read: A reviewer received and read the complete source text at this pinned content identity. This is review coverage, not a proof of correctness.
definitions.byte_identical_to_full_read: The pinned Git blob equals a directly read file. The alternate path context was inventoried, not separately semantically read.
definitions.not_semantically_reviewed: No full semantic review is claimed, even if the bytes were acquired and programmatically inspected.
definitions.exact_bytes_hash_verified: Local bytes match both the pinned Git blob SHA-1 and declared byte count. SHA-256 was also computed.
definitions.source_document_heuristic: Filename extension filter: md, py, sh, awk, b12s, b12asm, c, h, rs, go, html, js, ts, css. This does not establish human authorship; generated fixtures and frozen copies can match, and other formats are excluded.

limitations: The complete recursive tree was inventoried. Whole-repository semantic reading remains open.
Generated JSON/JSONL results, arrays, binary executables and compressed evidence were largely inventoried rather than downloaded and interpreted.
Programmatic full-byte scans and Python AST parsing are explicitly separate from semantic reading; repository code was not imported or executed.
Deliberately malformed source fixtures exposed connector text/byte fidelity limits. Mismatching copies were excluded from exact acquisition counts.
Hash identity detects byte equality. It does not establish semantic correctness, execution approval, independent reproduction or observed performance.
No raw private repository source, credentials, personal operational identifiers or downloaded archives are included in this public metadata checkpoint.
publication_scope: Aggregates plus the directly read source references. The complete private repository inventory is retained separately from this public project.
